METALWORK — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Assembly Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawings.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawings.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawings.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawings.

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

3. When learning Project 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.

8. When learning Forging, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Forging.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Forging.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Forging.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Forging.

9. When learning Project 1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 1.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 1.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project 1.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 1.

10. When learning Gas Welding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Gas Welding.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Gas Welding.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Gas Welding.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Gas Welding.

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

12. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

13. When learning Metalwork related businesses, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork related businesses.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork related businesses.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork related businesses.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork related businesses.

14. When learning Surface Finishing Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Finishing Processes.

15. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

----
